rules.description: Win+D: show desktop
Excel: F4 toggles absolute/relative references (Cmd+T)
Alt+F4: quit application
Browser: F5 / Ctrl+F5 refresh, F11 full screen, Alt+Left/Right back/forward, Ctrl +/-/0 zoom
Excel: Ctrl+Arrows to Cmd+Arrows (navigate cell ranges)
Win+Arrows: snap window (Left/Right halves, Up maximize/fill, Down minimize)

to.shell_command: osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to tell (first application process whose frontmost is true) to click menu item "Left" of menu 1 of menu item "Move & Resize" of menu "Window" of menu bar 1'

osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to tell (first application process whose frontmost is true) to click menu item "Right" of menu 1 of menu item "Move & Resize" of menu "Window" of menu bar 1'
osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to tell (first application process whose frontmost is true) to click menu item "Fill" of menu "Window" of menu bar 1'

rules.description: Win+Shift+Down: restore window to its previous (pre-snap) size

to.shell_command: osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to tell (first application process whose frontmost is true) to click menu item "Return to Previous Size" of menu 1 of menu item "Move & Resize" of menu "Window" of menu bar 1'

rules.description: Win+Alt+Arrows: snap to quarters (Left/Right = top corners, Shift for bottom corners)

to.shell_command: osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to tell (first application process whose frontmost is true) to click menu item "Top Left" of menu 1 of menu item "Move & Resize" of menu "Window" of menu bar 1'

osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to tell (first application process whose frontmost is true) to click menu item "Top Right" of menu 1 of menu item "Move & Resize" of menu "Window" of menu bar 1'

osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to tell (first application process whose frontmost is true) to click menu item "Bottom Left" of menu 1 of menu item "Move & Resize" of menu "Window" of menu bar 1'

osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to tell (first application process whose frontmost is true) to click menu item "Bottom Right" of menu 1 of menu item "Move & Resize" of menu "Window" of menu bar 1'

rules.description: Alt+Space: open the Window menu (Windows window-control menu)

to.shell_command: osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to tell (first application process whose frontmost is true) to click menu bar item "Window" of menu bar 1'

rules.description: Win+Ctrl+D: create a new virtual desktop (Space)

to.shell_command: osascript -e 'tell application "Mission Control" to launch' -e 'delay 0.4' -e 'tell application "System Events" to tell process "Dock" to click button 1 of group "Spaces Bar" of group 1 of group "Mission Control"' -e 'delay 0.3' -e 'tell application "System Events" to key code 53'

rules.description: Ctrl+Win+Left/Right: switch virtual desktops (Spaces)
Win alone: Start menu (Spotlight) — hold Win for Win+key shortcuts
Win+R: Run (Spotlight)
Win+M: minimize all windows of current app
Win+A: Quick Settings (Control Center)

to.shell_command: osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to tell process "ControlCenter" to click menu bar item "Control Center" of menu bar 1'

rules.description: Win+N: Notification Center

to.shell_command: osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to tell process "ControlCenter" to click menu bar item "Clock" of menu bar 1'

rules.description: Win+P: display settings
Win+U: accessibility settings
Win+E: open File Explorer (new Finder window on Home)
Win+L: lock screen
Win+I: open Settings (System Settings)
Win+Shift+S: snip region to clipboard
Win+S: search (Spotlight) — overrides Cmd+S save; use Ctrl+S to save
Win+Space: switch input source (needs 2+ input sources enabled)
Win+. (period): emoji picker
Ctrl+Esc: Start menu (Spotlight)
Ctrl+Shift+Esc: Task Manager (Activity Monitor)
Ctrl+Alt+Delete: Force Quit dialog
PrintScreen: Snipping Tool (screenshot toolbar); Alt+PrtScn: window to clipboard; Win+PrtScn: full screen to file
Ctrl+letter → Cmd+letter: copy/paste/cut, undo/redo, select all, save, find, new, open, print, tabs, bold/italic/underline… (Shift passes through; terminals excluded)
Ctrl+Insert / Shift+Insert: copy / paste
Ctrl+Backspace / Ctrl+Delete: delete previous/next word
Home/End: start/end of line; Ctrl+Home/End: start/end of document (Shift to select)
PageUp/PageDown: move the cursor a page (Windows style; Shift to select works natively)
Explorer→Finder: Delete moves to Trash, Shift+Delete deletes permanently, F2 renames, Alt+Enter Get Info, Alt+Up parent folder
Explorer→Finder: Enter opens the selected item (rename with F2)
